CLI Reference

All 49 commands, slash commands, and keyboard shortcuts.

49 results
claudeCLI

Start interactive session

e.g.claude
claude "task"CLI

Run a one-time task without interactive session

e.g.claude "fix the build error"
claude -p "query"CLI

One-off query, print result and exit

e.g.claude -p "explain this function"
claude -cCLI

Continue most recent conversation in current directory

e.g.claude -c
claude -rCLI

Resume a previous conversation (opens picker)

e.g.claude -r
claude --resume <name>CLI

Resume a named session directly

e.g.claude --resume auth-refactor
claude --continueCLI

Continue the most recent conversation

e.g.claude --continue
claude --from-pr <number>CLI

Resume session linked to a pull request

e.g.claude --from-pr 123
claude --worktree [name]CLI

Start Claude in a new isolated git worktree

e.g.claude --worktree feature-auth
claude --permission-mode planCLI

Start session in read-only Plan Mode

e.g.claude --permission-mode plan
claude --permission-mode auto-editCLI

Start with Auto-Accept Mode (auto-approves edits)

claude --dangerously-skip-permissionsCLI

Skip all permission prompts (use in sandboxed envs only)

claude --output-format jsonCLI

Output as JSON (use with -p)

e.g.claude -p "list endpoints" --output-format json
claude --output-format stream-jsonCLI

Output streaming JSON in real-time

e.g.cat log.txt | claude -p "parse errors" --output-format stream-json
claude --allowedTools "Edit,Bash(git *)"CLI

Restrict which tools Claude can use

claude --verboseCLI

Show detailed output including thinking

claude mcp addCLI

Add an MCP server interactively

e.g.claude mcp add
claude mcp listCLI

List configured MCP servers

e.g.claude mcp list
claude mcp remove <name>CLI

Remove an MCP server

e.g.claude mcp remove github
